description: Use when the user wants to start building now. Returns the ordered steps: 1) call the API with the public demo key (copy-paste curl), 2) get an own sandbox key via the agent device login (a human approves with Google, no form, no card), 3) build against sandbox data, 4) production: a human registers a card and activates production, then each end customer authorizes their bank. Lists exactly which steps an agent can do alone and which need a human. Takes no parameters. Read-only; it never creates keys or connections.
name: connecta_getting_started
title: Start with RPG Connecta
